notes.title: ARMORED KITTEN REMASETER
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30645921/4f8f00788b8e42ebb57aac417055d806704360ac.png[/img]
Sup guys!

I've been talking about some mythical game remaster for a long time now.

Today I want to invite you to play it.
It's still in active developement, but you already may check it out!

To play it you must:
[olist]
[*]Open your [b]Steam Client[/b] and find Armored Kitten in your library
[*]Click Right Mouse Button on the game's title and choose [b]Properties[/b]
[*]Go to Betas and click the [b]None [/b]button
[*]Choose the [b]beta - Alpha version of AKRemaster[/b] branch
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30645921/c20a122e48331a7c8c789d7754765f08e7c2dee1.png[/img]
The game files will be updated, and now you're free to play the Remastered version.

It's still have something old that needs to be removed, something unfinished new...
The gameplay isn't balanced yet.
The story has no ending and it'll loop to the 1st level.
But you can gat overall idea of what is coming.

Please share your thoughts about the upcoming remaser in the comments!
